theme.en: AI Supply Chains Expand Under Intensifying Scrutiny
theme.zh: AI供应链扩张伴随更严格的审视

dek.en: SK hynix orders HBM4 equipment and develops supplier-validation infrastructure as TSMC approves a $500 million investment company. Calls for leadership changes at Nvidia, proposals for tighter China export controls and a continuing DRAM antitrust case bring governance and legal scrutiny into the expansion cycle.
dek.zh: SK海力士订购HBM4设备并建设供应商验证设施，台积电则批准设立5亿美元投资公司。要求Nvidia调整领导层的呼声、收紧对华出口管制的提议，以及继续推进的DRAM反垄断诉讼，使公司治理与法律审视成为这轮扩张的重要议题。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Bessent Urges Nvidia to Choose an Outside CEO
title.zh: Bessent敦促Nvidia从外部选聘CEO

summary.en: Bessent calls for a major shakeup at Nvidia and urges the company to choose an outside CEO, CNBC reports. The intervention raises the stakes of Nvidia's leadership search for customers and suppliers planning around its AI accelerator roadmap.
summary.zh: 据CNBC报道，Bessent要求Nvidia进行重大调整，并敦促公司从外部选聘CEO。对于围绕Nvidia AI加速器路线图制定计划的客户和供应商，这一表态使公司领导层人选的影响进一步扩大。

title.en: IEDM 2026 Preview Highlights Faster, More Efficient AI Hardware
title.zh: IEDM 2026前瞻聚焦更快、更高效的AI硬件

summary.en: SemiWiki's preview of the upcoming IEDM 2026 highlights research addressing AI demand for more computing power, faster memory and better energy efficiency. These directions matter to accelerator roadmaps because compute performance, memory access and power consumption jointly constrain AI systems.
summary.zh: SemiWiki对即将举行的IEDM 2026的前瞻，聚焦应对AI算力、更快存储器和更高能效需求的研究。这些方向关系到加速器路线图，因为计算性能、存储访问与功耗共同制约AI系统的扩展。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC Approves $500 Million Investment Company for Chip Firms and Suppliers
title.zh: 台积电批准设立5亿美元投资公司，支持芯片企业与供应商

summary.en: TSMC approves a $500 million investment company to back chip businesses and, for the first time, its own suppliers, Dealroom reports. The vehicle creates a direct financing channel into the foundry's broader ecosystem, linking equity investment with the development of its customer and supplier base.
summary.zh: 据Dealroom报道，台积电批准设立5亿美元投资公司，支持芯片企业，并首次将自身供应商纳入投资范围。这一载体为其代工生态提供直接融资渠道，将股权投资与客户及供应商体系的发展联系起来。

title.en: TSMC Receives Record Aid as Fab Expansion Continues
title.zh: 台积电扩建晶圆厂，获得创纪录补助

summary.en: TSMC receives record government aid as it expands its fabs, Taipei Times reports. Public support affects the financing of construction and equipment costs, making subsidies an important part of the economics of its manufacturing expansion.
summary.zh: 据Taipei Times报道，台积电在扩建晶圆厂的同时获得创纪录的政府补助。公共资金影响厂房建设与设备支出的融资安排，使补贴成为其制造业务扩张成本收益的重要组成部分。

title.en: Memory & Storage
title.zh: 存储器与存储系统

title.en: CXMT Plans Limited HBM3E Production as Yields Trail SK hynix
title.zh: 长鑫存储计划小规模生产HBM3E，良率仍落后于SK海力士

summary.en: CXMT plans limited HBM3E production while its yields trail SK hynix, TokenPost reports. The reported yield gap makes manufacturing execution central to how much usable AI memory the company can deliver as it enters this market.
summary.zh: 据TokenPost报道，长鑫存储计划开展小规模HBM3E生产，其良率仍落后于SK海力士。报道所述的良率差距意味着，在进入这一市场的过程中，制造环节的执行能力将直接影响公司能够交付的合格AI存储器数量。

title.en: SK hynix Places Equipment Orders on Broader HBM4 Demand
title.zh: SK海力士面向更广泛的HBM4需求下达设备订单

summary.en: SK hynix places new equipment orders as it anticipates HBM4 demand beyond Nvidia, TechPowerUp reports. The spending ties next-generation memory capacity plans to expectations of a broader AI accelerator customer base.
summary.zh: 据TechPowerUp报道，SK海力士预期Nvidia以外的客户也将带来HBM4需求，并据此下达新设备订单。这笔投入将下一代存储器的产能规划与更广泛的AI加速器客户需求预期联系起来。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: SK hynix Targets May 2027 Completion for 874.6 Billion Won Trinity Fab
title.zh: SK海力士计划于2027年5月建成投资8746亿韩元的Trinity Fab

summary.en: SK hynix plans to complete its 874.6 billion won Trinity Fab in May 2027, BigGo Finance reports. The facility is intended to lower barriers to mass-production validation for chip materials and equipment, helping suppliers qualify products for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary.zh: 据BigGo Finance报道，SK海力士计划于2027年5月建成投资8746亿韩元的Trinity Fab。该设施旨在降低芯片材料与设备开展量产验证的门槛，帮助供应商完成面向半导体制造的产品验证。

title.en: EV Group Targets Manufacturing Challenges in Qubit Scaling
title.zh: EV Group着手应对量子比特规模化的制造挑战

summary.en: EV Group outlines manufacturing support aimed at scaling qubits, New Electronics reports. For quantum hardware developers, reproducible fabrication is essential to increasing qubit counts and integrating larger devices, connecting equipment capabilities with system expansion.
summary.zh: 据New Electronics报道，EV Group提出面向量子比特规模扩大的制造支持方案。对于量子硬件开发商，可重复的制造工艺是增加量子比特数量和集成更大规模器件的基础，使设备能力与系统扩展紧密相连。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: DRAM Antitrust Case Against Samsung, SK hynix and Micron Proceeds
title.zh: 针对三星、SK海力士与美光的DRAM反垄断诉讼继续推进

summary.en: Samsung, SK hynix and Micron fail to win dismissal of a DRAM antitrust suit, TechPowerUp reports. The decision allows the claims to proceed, keeping the suppliers' market conduct under legal scrutiny.
summary.zh: 据TechPowerUp报道，三星、SK海力士与美光未能成功申请驳回一宗DRAM反垄断诉讼。这一决定使相关指控得以继续进入诉讼程序，三家供应商的市场行为将持续受到法律审视。

title.en: US Lawmakers Seek Tighter AI Chip Export Curbs on China
title.zh: 美国议员推动收紧对华AI芯片出口限制

summary.en: US lawmakers push for tougher AI chip export restrictions on China following the Nvidia controversy, Hindustan Times reports. Any resulting restrictions would affect the addressable market for advanced accelerators and the compliance requirements of their sales channels.
summary.zh: 据Hindustan Times报道，在Nvidia相关争议发生后，美国议员正推动对华实施更严格的AI芯片出口限制。由此产生的限制措施将影响先进加速器可进入的市场，以及销售渠道需要满足的合规要求。

theme.en: Interfaces and Variability Shape Efficient AI Hardware
theme.zh: 界面工程与变异性补偿推动高效AI硬件

dek.en: Ferroelectric devices, magnetic p-bit arrays and superconducting circuits address memory operation, variation compensation and neural computation. Photonic simulation and activity-aware SNN pruning extend the reading queue to cross-layer design and workload efficiency.
dek.zh: 铁电器件、磁性p-bit阵列与超导电路分别推进存储操作、变异性补偿和神经计算。光子仿真与面向脉冲活动的SNN剪枝进一步将研究视角延伸至跨层设计和工作负载效率。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Room-Temperature Montmorillonite Dielectrics Enable Low-Voltage 2D Transistors
title.zh: 室温加工的蒙脱石介电层支持低电压二维晶体管

papers.authors: Wen-Jie Li, Jun-Ying Xue, Peng Chen, et al.

summary.en: An aqueous montmorillonite ink forms a solution-processed dielectric at room temperature, and all-solution-processed MoS2 transistors operate at 1 V with hysteresis as low as 1 mV. The organic-free formulation removes the need for ligand-removal annealing and works with several n-type and p-type 2D semiconductors. The result offers a low-thermal-budget route to gate dielectrics for temperature-sensitive integration.
summary.zh: 研究利用水系蒙脱石墨水在室温下形成溶液加工介电层，全溶液加工的MoS2晶体管可在1 V下工作，迟滞最低达到1 mV。该配方不含有机组分，省去了去除配体所需的退火步骤，并适用于多种n型与p型二维半导体。这为对温度敏感的集成工艺提供了一条低热预算栅介电层制备路径。

title.en: Nb2O5 Interlayers Improve Polarization and Resistance Contrast in HZO Tunnel Junctions
title.zh: Nb2O5中间层提升HZO隧道结的极化与电阻态对比度

papers.authors: Hyungseok Lee, Hyo-Bae Kim, Gunho Kim, et al.

summary.en: Replacing an Al2O3 interlayer with Nb2O5 raises PUND-derived 2Pr from 17.2 to 27.4 μC/cm² in HZO ferroelectric tunnel junctions with matched layer and total stack thicknesses. At a 1.2 V read voltage, the tunneling electroresistance ratio rises from 36 to 60, with a larger relative current increase in the low-resistance state. The controlled comparison identifies interlayer selection as a lever for tuning polarization and readout contrast in nonvolatile memory.
summary.zh: 在HZO层厚与介电堆叠总厚度保持一致的铁电隧道结中，以Nb2O5替代Al2O3中间层，使通过PUND测得的2Pr从17.2提高至27.4 μC/cm²。在1.2 V读取电压下，隧穿电致电阻比从36升至60，低阻态电流的相对增幅更大。这一控制变量比较表明，中间层材料选择可用于调节非易失存储器的极化与读取对比度。

title.en: All-ALD Growth Supports Reliable Sub-2-nm Hafnia Tunnel Junctions
title.zh: 全原子层沉积工艺支持高可靠性的亚2nm氧化铪隧道结

papers.authors: Ren-Hao Xue, Yu-Shi Sun, Rui-Zhan Yan, et al.

summary.en: An all-atomic-layer-deposition process produces sub-2-nm hafnia ferroelectric tunnel junctions operating below 2 V with a breakdown field of about 12.1 MV/cm. The work combines controlled growth and low-roughness interfaces to address reliability during barrier scaling. Four-bit nonvolatile multilevel operation also supports an in-memory-computing simulation reporting 95.78% accuracy.
summary.zh: 研究采用全原子层沉积工艺制备亚2nm氧化铪铁电隧道结，实现低于2 V的工作电压，击穿场强约为12.1 MV/cm。该工作通过精确控制生长过程和形成低粗糙度界面，应对势垒减薄带来的可靠性问题。器件还实现4 bit非易失多级操作，并在基于该特性的存内计算仿真中报告95.78%的准确率。

title.en: Circuits & Reliability
title.zh: 电路与可靠性

title.en: Magnetic p-Bit Arrays Compensate Device Variation for Stochastic Neural Computing
title.zh: 磁性p-bit阵列通过器件变异性补偿实现随机神经计算

papers.authors: Jia-Chen Bao, Song-Song Li, Rui-Zhi Ren, et al.

summary.en: A chip-level array of voltage-controlled magnetic-anisotropy MTJs uses a tail-truncation strategy to compensate variation in probabilistic switching ranges. The chip implements restricted Boltzmann machines and deep belief networks for image recognition, anomaly detection, image completion and generation. Joint adjustment of voltage-pulse amplitude and duration adds a control mechanism for improving network performance, making device calibration central to scaling probabilistic hardware.
summary.zh: 研究在芯片级电压控制磁各向异性MTJ阵列中引入尾部截断策略，补偿器件概率开关范围的差异。该芯片实现受限玻尔兹曼机与深度信念网络，用于图像识别、异常检测、图像补全和生成。联合调节电压脉冲幅度与持续时间，为改善网络性能增加了控制手段，也使器件校准成为概率计算硬件扩展的重要环节。

title.en: Multi-Weight AQFP Cells Demonstrate Superconducting Neural-Circuit Building Blocks
title.zh: 多权重AQFP单元展示超导神经电路基础模块

papers.authors: Yu-Xing He, Yi-Fan Kong, Yu-Hao Yang, et al.

summary.en: A three-inductor transformer gives adiabatic quantum-flux-parametron cells multiple output-current amplitudes by tuning the intermediate inductance. Numerical simulations verify weighted current summation and threshold activation, and fabricated circuits measured at 4.2 K confirm multi-weight synaptic-cell and threshold-controlled operation. The results provide measured circuit building blocks for superconducting neural hardware.
summary.zh: 研究通过三电感变压器调节中间电感，使绝热量子磁通参量器件（AQFP）单元产生多级输出电流幅度。数值仿真验证了加权电流求和与阈值激活，制备电路在4.2 K下的测量进一步确认了多权重突触单元与阈值控制功能。这些结果为超导神经硬件提供了经过实测的电路基础模块。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Polarization Selects Memory and Threshold Modes in α-In2Se3 Memristors
title.zh: 极化控制α-In2Se3忆阻器的存储与阈值开关模式

papers.authors: Soo-Hyun Lee, Jong-Hyun Kim, Hyeong-Kyu Jin, et al.

summary.en: In a low-compliance-current regime, ferroelectric polarization selects nonvolatile memory switching or volatile threshold switching in a single α-In2Se3-based memristor through a decoupled in-plane poling terminal. The devices report a 4.7% coefficient of variation in set voltage and stable operation over more than 9,000 cycles. Combining both modes on one material platform supplies the volatile dynamics and nonvolatile readout weights needed for physical reservoir computing.
summary.zh: 研究在低限流条件下，通过独立的面内极化端口调控铁电极化，使单个α-In2Se3忆阻器可在非易失存储开关与易失阈值开关模式之间选择。器件置位电压的变异系数为4.7%，并实现超过9000次循环的稳定操作。同一材料平台兼具两种模式，可提供物理储备池计算所需的易失动态响应与非易失读出权重。

title.en: A Vertical Transistor Integrates a Multiscale Reservoir and Nonvolatile Readout
title.zh: 垂直晶体管集成多时间尺度储备池与非易失读出

papers.authors: Qin-Yong Dai, Hang-Yuan Cui, Yi-Shan Cao, et al.

summary.en: A vertical organic transistor integrates a multi-timescale photoelectric reservoir with a linear ferroelectric readout, allowing their dynamics and weights to be tuned independently. A Rubrene/F16CuPc heterojunction provides wavelength-dependent relaxation, and a ferroelectric stack provides symmetric nonvolatile weight updates with retention exceeding 3,000 seconds. The integration addresses the differing device requirements of reservoir and readout layers in edge machine vision.
summary.zh: 研究在垂直有机场效应晶体管中集成多时间尺度光电储备池与线性铁电读出，使动态响应与权重能够独立调节。Rubrene/F16CuPc异质结提供随波长变化的弛豫过程，铁电堆叠则实现对称的非易失权重更新，保持时间超过3000秒。这种集成方式针对边缘机器视觉中储备池层与读出层各自不同的器件需求提供了解决路径。

title.en: Hardware-Relevant AI Research
title.zh: 面向硬件的AI研究

title.en: Homeostatic Metabolic Pruning Targets Energy-Efficient Spiking Networks
title.zh: 稳态代谢剪枝面向高能效脉冲神经网络

papers.authors: Jun-Xiang Zhang, Jiang-Rong Shen, Hui-Yan Xue, et al.

summary.en: An activity-aware SNN pruning framework uses accumulated firing traces to remove hyperactive redundancy, then adjusts BatchNorm biases and gradient weights during homeostatic fine-tuning. It preserves information-dense convolutional layers and compresses parameter-heavy fully connected layers more aggressively. By incorporating firing activity into structural learning, the method targets both parameter storage and the event-processing work that drives neuromorphic energy consumption.
summary.zh: 研究提出面向活动水平的SNN剪枝框架，利用累积发放轨迹去除过度活跃的冗余结构，再通过稳态微调调整BatchNorm偏置与梯度权重。该方法保留信息密集的卷积层，并对参数较多的全连接层进行更大幅度压缩。通过将发放活动纳入结构学习，方法同时针对参数存储开销与影响神经形态能耗的事件处理工作量进行优化。

title.en: EDA & Design Tools
title.zh: EDA与设计工具

title.en: PISim Connects Photonic Architectures, Device Impairments and Neural Inference
title.zh: PISim联结光子架构、器件非理想因素与神经网络推理

summary.en: PISim couples neural-network execution to models of six photonic accelerator families, six modulator technologies and four optical-source organizations. It combines quantization, noise, thermal drift, loss and crosstalk with interface timing to evaluate electronic-optical bottlenecks. Demonstrations use simulated MNIST multilayer perceptrons, providing a common framework for examining accuracy and throughput trade-offs before fabrication.
summary.zh: PISim将神经网络执行与6类光子加速器架构、6种调制器技术及4种光源组织方式的模型相结合。该工具综合量化、噪声、热漂移、损耗、串扰与接口时序，评估电光协同中的瓶颈。演示采用MNIST多层感知机仿真，为流片前比较准确率与吞吐量之间的取舍提供统一框架。
